name: Objects in the Making
thesis: A nocturnal sculpture gallery lets Raygen’s machines hold the room, with quiet museum typography and an intimate glimpse of their maker.
interaction: Move between three focused objects with the collection rail or arrow keys; remove SERV0’s panels to reveal its aligned internal assembly.
why: The actual printers are treated as objects of fascination, their turquoise and yellow providing the color in a nearly black room, while Raygen’s personality appears in the small, candid maker note.
